top.titulo: Lufthansa to Slash 1,000 Jobs as Airlines Reel from High Fuel Costs
top.resumen_es: Europe’s biggest airline group, Lufthansa, plans to eliminate as many as 1,000 jobs and reduce capacity on short and medium-haul destinations, Bloomberg reported on Friday, citing a letter to employees it had seen. Lufthansa and all other airlines have struggled this year with increasing pressure on profits from soaring fuel prices amid the Middle East conflict.
